definitions.explanation: Two children born at the same birth.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{双子|ふたご}の{母親|ははおや}だ。
examples.english: She is a mother of twins.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}なのに{全然|ぜんぜん}{似|に}ていない。
examples.english: Even though they're twins, they don't look alike at all.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}の{姉妹|しまい}がクラスにいる。
examples.english: There are twin sisters in the class.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}を{育|そだ}てるのは{大変|たいへん}だが、{二人|ふたり}で{遊|あそ}んでくれるので{助|たす}かる。
examples.english: Raising twins is hard, but it helps that they play together.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}の{兄弟|きょうだい}は{顔|かお}がそっくりで、{先生|せんせい}でさえ{間違|まちが}えることがある。
examples.english: The twin brothers look so alike that even their teacher sometimes mistakes one for the other.

notes:
{双子|ふたご} is the everyday word for twins. Formed from {二|ふた}つ + {子|こ}.

TYPES:
- {一卵性|いちらんせい}{双生児|そうせいじ}: identical twins
- {二卵性|にらんせい}{双生児|そうせいじ}: fraternal twins

Note: {双生児|そうせいじ} is the formal/medical term for twins.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {双子|ふたご}の{兄弟|きょうだい}: twin brothers/siblings
- {双子|ふたご}の{姉妹|しまい}: twin sisters
- {双子|ふたご}を{育|そだ}てる: to raise twins

RELATED:
- {三つ子|みつご}: triplets
- {四つ子|よつご}: quadruplets
- {双子座|ふたござ}: Gemini (zodiac sign)

PROVERB:
{三つ子|みつご}の{魂|たましい}{百|ひゃく}まで — "The character formed by age three lasts to a hundred" (here {三つ子|みつご} means "a three-year-old," not "triplets").
